what: A golf design of Z_17 invariant under x -> -x: fifteen pairwise disjoint starters partitioning the edge set of the complete graph on Z_17 \ {0}. Starter 0 is the patterned starter P = {{x,-x}}; starters 2t+1 and 2t+2 are interchanged by negation. Its multiplier group is {1,16}, which by Theorem A of cyclic_layer_recursion_prime_census.md is the largest a golf design of a Fermat prime can have.
scope: This is a layer-1 object only. It is not a radius-five witness and has no bearing on the truth of Erdos-Rosenfeld #835, which remains open.
